name: MIRA
summary: MIRA is Midea's humanoid development platform for commercial and household service scenarios. Midea's annual report describes demonstrations involving appliances and drink preparation, including refrigerator and microwave interaction and coffee-related tasks. The project explores how mobile manipulation can connect a robot with everyday equipment and service routines.
